note: Triggers on reviewing IAM in an AWS CDK TypeScript app. Near-misses are a design review (architecture-review), a threat analysis (threat-model), IAM in non-CDK IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation), a change review (code-reviewer), and plain IAM Q&A. The skill is a scoped review that writes a file, so it sets disable-model-invocation and positives are explicit asks.

prompts.prompt: Review the IAM in this CDK app. Is anything over-broad?
prompts.note: Direct IAM review of a CDK app.

prompts.prompt: Check my roles and policies in infra/lib for least privilege.
prompts.note: 'Least privilege' and 'roles and policies' in a CDK path.

prompts.prompt: Why does the CancelOrder Lambda role have access to every S3 object? Trace where that grant comes from in the CDK stack.
prompts.note: 'Why does this role have access to X' in CDK.

prompts.prompt: Review this architecture for weak points and trade-offs.
Threat model the order API and map the trust boundaries.
Check the IAM policies in our Terraform modules for least privilege.
prompts.note: Near-miss: Terraform, out of scope. The skill would stop and say so.

prompts.prompt: Review my diff for bugs and missing tests.
prompts.note: Near-miss: change review, so the code-reviewer agent.

prompts.prompt: What is the difference between an IAM role and an IAM user?
prompts.note: Near-miss: plain IAM Q&A, no CDK code to review.
